Interactive Diff Review · `--auto-low` Policy · Branch & PR Workflow
Every proposed fix must survive 4 rigorous gate oracles sequentially:
Instant pure-ESM AST parse verification; blocks malformed syntax
Executes project's native build command (`npm run build` / `cargo check`)
Executes automated test runner (`npm test` / `pytest`); rejects regressions
Re-scans modified file; proves the original finding is completely resolved
✓ On Failure: Retry with Failure Evidence → Auto-Revert on Exhaustion
Single Binary (Node.js ≥ 18) · Pure ESM · Zero Build Step · Local-Only by Design · CADRE Platform Ecosystem
